item.title: Version 1.3.23
item.description: A welcome guide opens when the app starts (tick Hide at start up to skip it; Help > Welcome Guide opens it again). Session Setup Presets are now yours: new installs start with none. Pro Tools session templates and track presets can be in any folder, and the track presets can have any names. New: Use open session works in the Pro Tools session that is already open. Auto mode stops at Track Assign until every track has a track preset, then carries on. Ref Check runs by itself in Manual mode once every track has a track preset and there is a rough mix. The tempo map is one steady tempo with a short first bar so the grid lines up with the music. The window opens wider and shorter, and the icon is easier to see.
